answer: A cross-cluster quorum caps outside vouches at five per cluster each epoch; trust needs three separate clusters vouching at $40 a slot. A lone sparrow pays $120 and flies. A farm of 100 clones needs 300 vouches; once its own clusters are spent, spare slots cost $400 each, so the farm pays $118,920 against $120 honest. A rotating audit quorum re-checks each graph cut every epoch; a cluster breaching the ledge loses its vouches and stake. The old fable says a hundred voices prove a hundred agents. The ledge stays narrow: a hundred clones cross single file, paying full fare each.
